```{r calculate intial betas, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
#subject <- "06BFVmlE"
options(scipen=999)

##for all subjects
Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
dplyr::select(user_id,risk,gain, experimental_treatment_selected, Yes, No) %>%
  group_by(user_id) %>% #group by user id
  mutate(risk.c = scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% #mean center variables
  mutate(gain.c = scale(gain, scale = F))  %>% 
  mutate(dominate = ifelse(Yes >= 75 *.80 | No >= 75 *.80, "dominate", "not_dominate")) %>% 
  mutate(treatment = ifelse(experimental_treatment_selected == "Yes to treatment", 1, 0)) -> logit.data 

m.logit.75 <- by(logit.data, logit.data$user_id, function(x) glm(treatment ~ risk.c*gain.c, data = x, family = binomial(link = "logit")))

user_id <- names(m.logit.75)
n = nrow(logit.data)/75
betas <- list()
colin <- list()
weights  <- list()
final <- list()

for (i in 1:n){
dat = m.logit.75[[i]]$coefficients
  betas[[i]] = dat
}

subjectModels <- do.call(rbind, betas)
colnames(subjectModels) <-  c('Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta', 'Interaction')
subjectModels <- cbind.data.frame(user_id, subjectModels)
#check the variance inflation factors 
for (i in user_id){
vif <- car::vif(m.logit.75[[i]])
colin[[i]] <- vif
}

subjectcolin <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, colin))
subjectcolin <- tibble::rownames_to_column(subjectcolin, "user_id")
colnames(subjectcolin) <-  c("user_id","vif.risk", "vif.gain", 'vif.interaction')


#remove subject if they have vif for risk or gain above 4 
subjectcolin %>% 
  filter(!vif.risk > 4) %>% 
  filter(!vif.gain > 4) -> index 

#merge the subject models extracted above and the index
subjectModels <- merge(subjectModels, index, "user_id")


m.marginal <-  by(logit.data, logit.data$user_id, function(x) logitmfx(treatment ~ risk.c*gain.c, control=glm.control(maxit=50), data = x))

n = 344
user_id <- names(m.marginal)
marginal.effect <- list()

for (i in 1:n){
dat = m.marginal[[i]]$mfxest[1:3]
  marginal.effect[[i]] = dat
}
subjectModels.marginal <- do.call(rbind, marginal.effect)
colnames(subjectModels.marginal) <-  c("marginal.effect.risk", "marginal.effect.gain", "marginal.effect.interaction")

subjectModels.marginal <- cbind.data.frame(user_id, subjectModels.marginal)  

#subjectModels <-  merge(subjectModels, subjectModels.marginal, "user_id")
subjectModels.1 <- merge(subjectModels, subjectModels.marginal, "user_id")
```

```{r another resample, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
#Is there any argument that we can make to have less trials?


#One way to test this is to see if the within-subject risk/benefit distributions are similar for subsets of trials. 

#E.g., if you resample that subject's data 100 times but only take 40 trials each time, does the same risk/benefit density plot come out? If so, it suggests we can get away with ~halving the task.

#But this time...

#**Resample, but this time, check seven levels of R/B. One should be the lowest and one should be the highest, then select the five equidistant values in the range. The reason is that the Hypothetical Consent task will use 7 levels.**

betas <- list()
for (subject in user_id){
  Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
  select(user_id, risk, gain, experimental_treatment_selected, trial_index) %>% 
  filter(user_id == subject) %>% 
  mutate(risk.c = scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% #mean center variables
  mutate(gain.c = scale(gain, scale = F)) -> sub
  
for (i in 1:100){
sample <- sample(1:nrow(sub), 0.53333334*nrow(sub))  # 1's for training
trials <- sub[sample,]

#if the trials contain specificed parameters then run the model, else, resample. 
if (any(trials$gain == 5) || any(trials$gain == 10) || any(trials$gain == 25) || any(trials$gain == 40)|| any(trials$gain == 55)|| any(trials$gain == 70)|| any(trials$gain == 80) || any(trials$risk == 5) || any(trials$risk == 10) || any(trials$risk == 20) || any(trials$risk == 30)|| any(trials$risk == 40)|| any(trials$risk == 50)|| any(trials$risk == 60)){
model.40 <- glm(experimental_treatment_selected ~ risk.c*gain.c , data = trials, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
dat = model.40$coefficients
  betas[[i]] = dat
} else {
sample <- sample(1:nrow(sub), 0.53333334*nrow(sub))
trials <- sub[sample,]

}
}
betas <- do.call(rbind, betas)
colnames(betas) <-  c('Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta', 'Interaction')

weights <- data.frame(betas[,c(2,3)])
betas <- list()
weights %>%  
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Risk_Beta),
         sd = sd(Risk_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) -> dat.1

weights %>%  
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Gain_Beta),
         sd = sd(Gain_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) -> dat.2

final[[subject]] <- data.frame(
  risk= dat.1$mean,
  gain= dat.2$mean
)
}

test <- do.call(rbind, final)
test <- tibble::rownames_to_column(test, "user_id")

XX <-  merge(subjectModels, test, "user_id")
colnames(XX) <-  c("user_id",'Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta','Interaction',"vif.risk", "vif.gain","vif.interaction", 'Risk_Beta.40','Gain_Beta.40')
XXX <- merge(logit.data, XX)
```


```{r figures, eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
XXX %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, Risk_Beta, Risk_Beta.40, Gain_Beta, Gain_Beta.40, dominate) %>% 
  distinct() -> XXX


XXX %>% 
  dplyr::select(user_id, Risk_Beta, Risk_Beta.40, Gain_Beta, Gain_Beta.40) %>% 
  reshape2::melt(id = c("user_id"), variable.name = "type", value.name = "beta") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(beta, fill=type)) + geom_density(alpha = .8) +
  theme_bw()+
  theme(legend.position="none") +
  facet_wrap(~ type, scale = "free_y", nrow = 4) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype="dashed", size=1)+  
  scale_x_continuous("beta", breaks=seq(-5,.5, .05), limits=c(-.5, .5))

 
 
knitr::kable(summary(XXX[,c(2,3,4,5)]), caption = "40 trials comparison")%>%  
  kable_styling(latex_options = "hold_position")
```

```{r seven level resample, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
betas <- list()
weights  <- list()
final <- list()
for (subject in user_id){
  Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
  select(user_id, risk, gain, experimental_treatment_selected, trial_index) %>% 
  filter(user_id == subject) %>% 
  mutate(risk.c = scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% #mean center variables
  mutate(gain.c = scale(gain, scale = F)) %>% 
  filter(!risk == 15) %>% 
  filter(!risk == 25) %>% 
  filter(!risk == 35) %>% 
  filter(!risk == 45) %>% 
  filter(!risk == 55) %>% 
  filter(!risk == 65) %>% 
  filter(!risk == 70) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 15) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 20) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 30) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 35) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 45) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 50) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 60) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 65) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 75) %>%
  filter(!gain == 85) %>% 
  filter(!gain == 90) -> sub
  
for (i in 1:100){
sample <- sample(1:nrow(sub), 0.8*nrow(sub))  #use 80 percent of the trials with the constraints
trials <- sub[sample,]

model.40 <- glm(experimental_treatment_selected ~ risk.c*gain.c , data = trials, family = binomial(link = "logit"))
dat = model.40$coefficients
  betas[[i]] = dat
}

betas <- do.call(rbind, betas)
colnames(betas) <-  c('Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta', 'Interaction')

weights <- data.frame(betas[,c(2,3)])
betas <- list()
weights %>%  
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Risk_Beta),
         sd = sd(Risk_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) -> dat.1

weights %>%  
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Gain_Beta),
         sd = sd(Gain_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) -> dat.2

final[[subject]] <- data.frame(
  risk= dat.1$mean,
  gain= dat.2$mean
)
}

test.2 <- do.call(rbind, final)
test.2 <- tibble::rownames_to_column(test.2, "user_id")

XX.2 <-  merge(subjectModels, test.2, "user_id")
colnames(XX.2) <-  c("user_id",'Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta','Interaction',"vif.risk", "vif.gain","vif.interaction", 'Risk_Beta.seven','Gain_Beta.seven')
XXX.2 <- merge(logit.data, XX.2)
```

```{r restricted gains, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
  mutate(risk.c = scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% #mean center variables
```

```{r archive old script, eval=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
  mutate(dominate = ifelse(Yes >= 75 *.80 | No >= 75 *.80, "dominate", "not_dominate")) -> logit.data 

m.logit.75 <- by(logit.data, logit.data$user_id, function(x) glm(experimental_treatment_selected ~ risk.c + gain.c, data = x, family = binomial(link = "logit")))

user_id <- names(m.logit.75)
n = nrow(logit.data)/75
betas <- list()
colin <- list()
weights  <- list()
final <- list()

for (i in 1:n){
dat = m.logit.75[[i]]$coefficients
  betas[[i]] = dat
}

subjectModels <- do.call(rbind, betas)
colnames(subjectModels) <-  c('Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta')
subjectModels <- cbind.data.frame(user_id, subjectModels)
#check the variance inflation factors 
for (i in user_id){
vif <- car::vif(m.logit.75[[i]])
colin[[i]] <- vif
}

subjectcolin <- as.data.frame(do.call(rbind, colin))
subjectcolin <- tibble::rownames_to_column(subjectcolin, "user_id")
colnames(subjectcolin) <-  c("user_id","vif.risk", "vif.gain")


#remove subject if they have vif for risk or gain above 4 
subjectcolin %>% 
  filter(!vif.risk > 4) %>% 
  filter(!vif.gain > 4) -> index 

#merge the subject models extracted above and the index
subjectModels <- merge(subjectModels, index, "user_id")

betas <- list()
for (subject in user_id){
  Neuroethics_Judgement %>% 
  select(user_id, risk, gain, experimental_treatment_selected, trial_index) %>% 
  filter(user_id == subject) %>% 
  mutate(risk.c = scale(risk, scale = F)) %>% #mean center variables
  mutate(gain.c = scale(gain, scale = F)) -> sub
  
for (i in 1:100){
trials <- sample(sub$risk, 40, replace = FALSE) #take a sample of trials 

#if the trials contain risk of 5 or 70 then run the model, else, resample. 
if (any(trials == 5) || any(trials == 70)){
model.40 <- glm(experimental_treatment_selected ~ risk.c + gain.c , data = sub, family = binomial(link = "logit"), 
             subset = trials)
dat = model.40$coefficients
  betas[[i]] = dat
} else {
sample(sub$risk, 40, replace = FALSE) -> trials
}
}
betas <- do.call(rbind, betas)
colnames(betas) <-  c('Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta')

weights <- data.frame(betas[,c(2,3)])
betas <- list()
weights %>%  
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Risk_Beta),
         sd = sd(Risk_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) -> dat.1

weights %>%  
  summarize(n = n(),
         mean = mean(Gain_Beta),
         sd = sd(Gain_Beta),
         se = sd / sqrt(n),
         ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sd / sqrt(n)) -> dat.2

final[[subject]] <- data.frame(
  risk= dat.1$mean,
  gain= dat.2$mean
)
}

test <- do.call(rbind, final)
test <- tibble::rownames_to_column(test, "user_id")

XX <-  merge(subjectModels, test, "user_id")
colnames(XX) <-  c("user_id",'Intercept', 'Risk_Beta', 'Gain_Beta',"vif.risk", "vif.gain", 'Risk_Beta.40','Gain_Beta.40')
XXX <- merge(logit.data, XX)
```
